'''Shavkat Abdullayevich Ayupov''' ({{Langx|ru|Шавкат Абдуллаевич Аюпов}}; born September 14, 1952, in [[Tashkent]]) is a [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] [[Uzbeks|Uzbek]] scientist in the field of [[mathematics]].<ref name=" Biography1">{{Cite web|url= https://twas.org/sites/default/files/ayupov_cv_-2021_main.pdf|title= CURRICULUM VITAE|website= twas.org |accessdate= 2023-10-21}}</ref><ref name= " Biography11" >{{Cite web|url= https://senat.uz/oz/senators/97|title= Аюпов Шавкат Абдуллаевич|website= senat.uz |accessdate= 2023-10-21}}</ref> He is an Academician of the Uzbekistan Academy of Sciences (1995).<ref name= " Biography2" >{{Cite web|url= https://www.academy.uz/ru/academics/members|title= Действительные члены АН РУз|website= www.academy.uz |accessdate= 2023-10-21}}</ref> He is also a Senator in the Senate of the [[Oliy Majlis]] of the [[Uzbekistan|Republic of Uzbekistan]] (2020).<ref name="Biography3">{{Cite web|url= https://centrasia.org/person2.php?st=1072166629|title= АЮПОВ Шавкат Абдуллаевич|website= centrasia.org |accessdate= 2023-10-21}}</ref> He was awarded the title of [[Hero of Uzbekistan]] in 2021, and he holds the title of Distinguished Scientist of the Republic of [[Uzbekistan]] (2011). President of [[Academy of Sciences of Uzbekistan]] from December 16, 2024.

He was elected a Fellow of [[the World Academy of Sciences]] and the [[International Core Academy of Sciences and Humanities]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Shavkat Ayupov-Core Academy |url=https://www.coreacad.org/Member.aspx?ProId=110 |access-date=2025-07-16 |website=www.coreacad.org}}</ref>
==Biography==
He was born into an intellectual family. His father, Abdulla Talipovich Ayupov, was a participant in the Great Patriotic War and headed the Department of [[Philosophy]] at [[Tashkent]] University.<ref name="Biography3" /><ref name= " Biography4" >{{Cite web|url= https://pamyat-naroda.ru/heroes/person-hero91976188/?backurl=%2Fheroes%2F%3Fstatic_hash%3D82aae3336a44823f06ad66bd02e41de6%26csrf%3De3288c9204fa40c3216a288cb3f7aa5a%26last_name%3D%D0%90%D1%8E%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%B2%26first_name%3D%D0%90%D0%B1%D0%B4%D1%83%D0%BB%D0%BB%D0%B0%26middle_name%3D%D0%A2%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87%26group%3Dall%26types%3Dpamyat_commander%3Anagrady_nagrad_doc%3Anagrady_uchet_kartoteka%3Anagrady_ubilein_kartoteka%3Apamyat_voenkomat%3Apotery_vpp%3Apamyat_zsp_parts%3Akld_polit%3Akld_upk%3Akld_vmf%3Apotery_doneseniya_o_poteryah%3Apotery_gospitali%3Apotery_utochenie_poter%3Apotery_spiski_zahoroneniy%3Apotery_voennoplen%3Apotery_iskluchenie_iz_spiskov%3Apotery_kartoteki%3Asame_doroga%26page%3D1|title= Аюпов Абдулла Талипович|website= pamyat-naroda.ru |accessdate= 2023-10-21}}</ref> His mother, Marguba Khamidova, was a doctor who worked as a therapist at the 4th City Clinical Hospital.<ref name="Biography3" />

He graduated from [[Tashkent]] University in 1974 and was a student of Academician T.A. Sarymsakov. He earned a Candidate of Physical and Mathematical Sciences degree (1977) and a Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences degree (1983).<ref name=" Biography1" /><ref name="Biography3" /><ref name= " Biography5" >{{Cite web|url= https://nlr.ru/e-case3/sc2.php/web_gak/lc/6897/20#pict|title= Генеральный алфавитный каталог книг на русском языке (1725 - 1998)|website= nlr.ru |accessdate= 2023-10-21}}</ref><ref name= " Biography6" >{{Cite web|url= https://nlr.ru/e-case3/sc2.php/web_gak/lc/6897/19#pict|title= Генеральный алфавитный каталог книг на русском языке (1725 - 1998)|website= nlr.ru |accessdate= 2023-10-21}}</ref>

He was a laureate of the [[Lenin Komsomol Prize]] as part of the authorial team consisting of Berdikulov, Musulmonkul Abdullaevich, Usmanov, Shukhrat Muttalibovich, and a research fellow at the Institute of Mathematics named after V.I. Romanovsky at the Academy of Sciences of the [[Uzbek Soviet Socialist Republic|Uzbek SSR]]; Abdullaev, Rustambai Zairovich, an assistant at the [[Tashkent State Pedagogic University named after Nizami|Tashkent State Pedagogical Institute]] named after V.I. Lenin; Tikhonov, Oleg Yevgenyevich, an assistant, and Trunov, Nikolai Vasilievich, an associate professor at the V.I. Ulyanov [[Kazan State University]], for their work on "Research on Operator Algebras and Non-Commutative Integration" (1989).

He became an Academician of the [[The World Academy of Sciences|World Academy of Sciences]] in 2003.<ref name="Biography3" /> From 2008 to 2013, he was an associated member of the Abdus Salam [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] (ICTP) in Trieste, Italy.<ref name="Biography3" /> He became a member of the Senate of the Oliy Majlis of the Republic of Uzbekistan in 2020.<ref name="Biography3" />

In 1992, he became the head of the Institute of Mathematics named after V.I. Romanovsky at the Academy of Sciences of the [[Republic of Uzbekistan]].<ref name=" Biography1" /><ref name= " Biography7" >{{Cite web|url= https://www.academy.uz/ru/page/uzbekiston-respublikasi-fanlar-akademiasi-viromanovskij-nomidagi-matematika-instituti|title= Институт математики имени В.И.Романовского Академии наук Республики Узбекистан|website= www.academy.uz |accessdate= 2023-10-21}}</ref>

In 1994, he embarked on a lengthy assignment at the University of [[Louis Pasteur]] in Strasbourg, France, where he conducted joint research with Professor J.-L. Lode.<ref name="Biography3" />
He teaches at the [[National University of Uzbekistan]] and is a professor of the Department of [[Algebra]] and [[Functional analysis|Functional Analysis]].<ref name= " Biography8" >{{Cite web|url= http://spa.nuu.uz/rus/staff/467|title= Национальный университет Узбекистана|website= spa.nuu.uz|accessdate= 2023-10-21}}{{Dead link|date=March 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

*  "Oʻzbekiston fan arbobi" (Distinguished Scientist of the Republic of Uzbekistan, 2011)<ref name="Biography3" /><ref name= "Biography11" />

*  Recipient of the State Prize of the 1st Degree in the field of science and technology (2017)<ref name="Biography3" /><ref name= "Biography11" />
